parameters.name: Names the person and supplies the fallback initials where supported.
parameters.slotId: The declared media slot of the photo, if any.
parameters.icon: A glyph in place of the initials (an entity, an unknown person).
parameters.tone: Selects the colour treatment for the avatar.
parameters.shape: A library shape mask in place of the circle (a hero moment).
parameters.style: Stateful visual overrides before the avatar theme.
